_comment: The look of the game (Session 4.5 visual upgrade, Gangstar-Vegas style). Change numbers here, not in code. Which effects run on Low / Medium / High is set in data/quality.json (postfx, bloom, shadowMapSize, softShadows, msaa).

toneMapping._comment: Filmic tone mapping makes bright colours roll off like a film camera. type: ACES (punchy, saturated), AgX (softer), Neutral (closest to raw colours), None. exposure: overall brightness.

lighting._comment: Sun and sky light strength for the upgraded look (overrides data/world.json → light intensities; colours still come from world.json). A stronger sun and a weaker sky fill make shadows readable.

bloom._comment: Glow around very bright things (neon, signs, the sun). threshold: how bright a pixel must be to glow (lower = more glow). strength: how strong. radius: how far it spreads (0-1).

grade._comment: Final colour grading, applied after tone mapping. saturation 1 = unchanged. contrast 1 = unchanged. warmth: + makes the image more orange, - more blue. vignette: darkening at the screen edges (0 = off).

shadows._comment: Real sun shadows around the player (Medium and High only). extent: half-width in metres of the shadowed area. distance: how far back along the sun ray the shadow camera sits. bias/normalBias fix stripes ('shadow acne'). minElevation (radians): the shadow-casting sun never goes lower than this, so sunset shadows stay a sensible length (the sky still shows the low sun). flagEverySeconds: how often new objects are checked for shadows.

neon._comment: Unlit glowing materials are multiplied by these so they are brighter than white and bloom. glow = neon strips and lights, sign = landmark name boards, marker = entrance rings.

water._comment: Lakes and the river reflect the sunset sky. roughness: 0 = mirror, 1 = matte. envIntensity: how strong the sky reflection is.

environment._comment: A small picture of the sky used for reflections (water now, real 3D cars and glass later). size in pixels per cube side.
